WITH w AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at, o.status,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS d
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900
)
SELECT d, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id,line_no)) dist_rl, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) orders, sum(net_amount) net, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM w WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-14' AND DATE '2025-12-24' GROUP BY d ORDER BY d;

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order o WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=d.calendar_date) dispatched,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order o WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)=d.calendar_date) ordered,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND r.return_date=d.calendar_date) rets
FROM dim_date d WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-13' AND DATE '2025-12-25' ORDER BY 1;

SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(o.web_order_id) matched
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-10' AND DATE '2025-12-26'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL;
